system.description: The Infernal Monster takes joy in crushing her enemies. This Charm permanently enhances its prerequisite. Whenever the Infernal kills a non-extra victim of Armageddon Nightmare Duel with an unarmed attack within the dreamscape, she regains two points of Willpower. If the victim intentionally commits suicide, the death yields only one point of Willpower. Accidental demise is unsatisfying. If the Infernal kills an enemy with an unarmed attack outside of the nightmare that she has previously killed in a nightmare, she regains three Willpower points. Sanity-Devouring Night Terror
